observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (3041 x 2243) blurred 3x3, in nine tiles at full size with a 0.02 grid and closer crops at 0.01, against the model rendered from the photo's anchor camera (out/recon/holistic/views/g094-a/render_model.png, render_id.png, lacking.jpg)
covers: SŁ-2M2 whole (all three columns, top rail to foot), the roof lining and its padded ledge over the console, the khaki cloth and the strip, bracket and plug just forward of the forward upright, the printed plates and the clutter just aft of the aft upright, the green cushion along the bottom
notes: The camera stands forward of the console's middle (the forward column is about a fifth taller in the image than the rear one; the view's eye is at y 2.08 against the console's 1.56), not aft of it as the observation says. The model's console is shorter than the BM3-1's: its three columns are 0.982 m faces cut from SAM Simulator's photos, so the top blocks (0062-6M, 0094-5, 0004-14M) are 45-65 mm strips where the photo has full blocks about 0.15 m high, and the bottom blocks (0051-7M, OK81-4M, OK51-6M) are 33-64 mm strips where the photo has blocks about 0.2 m high; below the faces the rack carcass is blank. The render still draws the senior operator's and deputy commander's seats up (the view's state says to hide them), so the bottom third of the console is judged from the cabin data's blocks and the strip of carcass visible between the seats. The render also draws an R-124 box (r124_a3) in front of the bottom middle block at (0.51-0.56, 0.88-0.95), and black hinge-like fittings on the racks' side edges and on fo_panel below the elevation hand wheel, none of which the photo shows. The holistic render draws fixtures, not the cabin's controls: where a knob or button is a control in data/cabins/osa_ak.json it is marked modelled with a note.
